Swerve Krakens Left Joystick.source:
test "Swerve Krakens Left Joystick"
device "frontLeft Drive Motor"
device "frontRight Drive Motor"
device "backLeft Drive Motor"
device "backRight Drive Motor"
device "controller0"

unsafe-exit "frontLeft Drive Motor".output
unsafe-exit "frontRight Drive Motor".output
unsafe-exit "backLeft Drive Motor".output
unsafe-exit "backRight Drive Motor".output

main:
    set "frontLeft Drive Motor".output = controller0.leftY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "frontRight Drive Motor".output = controller0.leftY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "backLeft Drive Motor".output = controller0.leftY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "backRight Drive Motor".output = controller0.leftY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    abort controller0.B

Swerve NEOs Right Joystick Until B.source:

device "frontLeft Angle Motor"
device "frontRight Angle Motor"
device "backLeft Angle Motor"
device "backRight Angle Motor"
device "controller0"

unsafe-exit "frontLeft Angle Motor".output
unsafe-exit "frontRight Angle Motor".output
unsafe-exit "backLeft Angle Motor".output
unsafe-exit "backRight Angle Motor".output

main:
    set "frontLeft Angle Motor".output = controller0.rightY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "frontRight Angle Motor".output = controller0.rightY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "backLeft Angle Motor".output = controller0.rightY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
    set "backRight Angle Motor".output = controller0.rightY deadband 0.12 scaled 0.20 default 0.0
